description: This file implements a GPU-accelerated 'lerp' (linear interpolation) operation for tensors on Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend within the PyTorch framework.

classes.name: MPSCachedGraph
classes.description: A cache class for MPS graph computations to avoid recomputing graph structures.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: Derived from MPSCachedGraph, holds placeholders for tensors involved in the lerp operation.

methods.name: TORCH_IMPL_FUNC
methods.description: Defines the implementation of the lerp operation on tensors for the MPS backend.
